common.name: Name
common.emptySet: The endpoint returned an empty set. This is not a load failure — the backend really has no data.

diag.unreachable: Cannot reach {{base}}. Confirm the backend is running (tools/dev-up.sh) and that the platform was started with --cors-origin.

hint.NETWORK_UNREACHABLE: The backend is not running, or the platform was started without --cors-origin. Run tools/dev-up.sh to start the engine and the platform.
hint.TIMEOUT: The request timed out. The engine is doing a long decision, or the backend process is stuck.
hint.NOT_FOUND: The object does not exist. The data directory may have been reset — refresh the list and pick again.
hint.PKG_VERIFY_UNAVAILABLE: The platform has no gate executor configured (--engine-url). Packages with approved test cases cannot be released because of this.
hint.VERSION_SELECTION_CONFLICT: This scenario mounts more than one ruleset, so the request must specify rulesetId.

scenes.title: Scenario policies
scenes.subtitle: Rulesets mounted by scenario (a list, not a node-linking canvas)
scenes.redline: Red line: this is not a flow canvas. A scenario policy is the list of rulesets mounted to a scenario; there is no drag-and-drop node orchestration.
scenes.redlineNote: The scenarios on this page are grouped from the scene field declared on rulesets — the backend has no separate scenario entity yet.
scenes.engineDown: Engine not connected: what you see below is the platform-side configuration and does not reflect what the engine is running. Trial runs and decisions will fail.
scenes.conflict: This scenario mounts more than one ruleset: callers must specify rulesetId, otherwise the engine returns VERSION_SELECTION_CONFLICT.

rulesets.title: Rulesets
rulesets.subtitle: A ruleset is a standalone rule module; expressions and decision tables are two ways of writing the same ruleset
rulesets.unapprovedTitle: Has unapproved test cases: the release gate will not actually execute any of them

facts.title: Fact catalog
facts.subtitle: Single source of truth: the field contract registry
facts.searchPlaceholder: Filter by field name or semantics
facts.notice: The fact catalog stores contracts only (name / type / semantics / missing handling / masking / version), never data retrieval — that belongs to an external Fact Provider. This page is read-only; register or revise via POST/PUT /api/v1/facts.

tests.title: Test cases
tests.subtitle: Business users mainly confirm test cases; whoever confirms an AI-generated expectation owns it
tests.notice: Only approved test cases are executed by the release gate. When a package contains no approved case the gate passes without verifying anything — that is a no-op, not a pass.
tests.emptyPending: No test case is waiting for confirmation. Switch to "All" to see approved and rejected ones.
tests.emptyAll: No ruleset contains any test case.

approval.title: Approval & release
approval.subtitle: Two-dimensional approval matrix: submitter type × risk level. Approving and publishing are real actions and are audited.
approval.hardRule: Hard rule: an agent can only submit drafts and can never publish; L4 rules cannot be submitted by an agent.
approval.empty: No change requests yet. Change requests are created by the submission flow — this page approves and publishes, it does not create them.
approval.noSelfApproval: self-approval is not allowed at this level
approval.readyToPublish: Approved and ready to publish. Publishing takes effect for this scenario from now on; in-flight requests finish on the old package.

sla.notApplicableTitle: No longer waiting for approval, so the SLA no longer counts

obs.title: Observability & audit
obs.subtitle: Three blocks, three sources — do not read them as one: decision logs are the engine's per-decision trail, the audit trail is what people did, the contract registry is static convention that does not change at runtime.

logs.question: Why did this decision come out this way?
logs.source: Structured logs pushed from engine to platform (masked view)
logs.note: Machine output, one entry per evaluation. Each entry can be replayed: recompute from the snapshot taken at the time and check whether decision and reason code still match.
logs.empty: No decision logs yet. The engine pushes a structured log to the platform on every decision — run a trial first, or send one decision from the engine side.

audit.question: Who changed what, and when?
audit.source: Operation events recorded by the platform itself (approval votes, releases, key rotation)
audit.note: Produced by people or by agents acting on their behalf, one entry per state transition. Decision-log entries never appear here, and vice versa.
audit.empty: No audit events yet. Approvals, releases and key rotation all leave a trace here.

enums.question: Which values may a decision or a reason code take?
enums.source: Contract docs contracts/01 §3.6 / §5 (compiled into code, not served by an endpoint)
enums.note: A static table. Changing it means changing the DSL contract. It does not change because of any single decision, and it takes no part in replay.
enums.decisionHint: Decides which branch this evaluation lands in
enums.reasonHint: Explains why this outcome was reached; logged reason codes start with one of these

editor.missingId: The URL has no ruleset ID
editor.saved: Saved to the platform (revision {{from}} → new version). The engine does not reload automatically, so trial runs still use the loaded package.
editor.jsonParse: The JSON in the editor failed to parse: {{message}}
editor.topNotObject: The top level must be an object
editor.defHint: Edit here directly; the backend runs a dry-run before saving
editor.exprNote: This ruleset is written as a decision table; open the "Decision table" view.
editor.tableNone: This ruleset uses expressions and has no decision table. The table view only has content when ruleset.table exists.
editor.validationIdle: Click "Validate" to run the backend dry-run compile: real fact catalog, real DSL compiler.
editor.validationEdited: validated against the current editor content
editor.validationStats: rules {{rules}} · slots {{slots}} · max depth {{depth}} · nodes {{nodes}} · assign {{assign}}
editor.validationOk: Validation passed with no errors or warnings.
editor.trialHint: The trial executes the package the engine has loaded, not the editor draft. After editing, save first and let the release flow hot-reload before the trial result changes.
editor.trialInputMustBeObject: Trial input must be an object: { "request.amount": "1500", ... }
editor.trialInputNotJson: Trial input is not valid JSON: {{message}}
editor.trialNoHit: No rule matched; the default decision was used.
